outcome: A WorkItem records local Git, local checks, and independent Evaluator evidence, and the customer view becomes delivered only from that executed evidence
acceptance: local Git inspect reports branch and HEAD without requiring GitHub
linking HEAD writes a commit code link and an executed scm check on the WorkItem
local typecheck and test runs write ci-run links and executed ci checks on the WorkItem
Evaluator records one check per acceptance criterion on the owning WorkItem
Generator self-check cannot mark customer progress delivered
notes or code links without executed checks cannot mark customer progress delivered
changing analysis, design, or acceptance makes prior executed evidence stale
missing or failed required executed evidence keeps customer progress out of delivered
developer progress inspector shows Agent, Code, CI, and Evidence
inScope: local Git inspect and HEAD link
local command runner for typecheck and test
outOfScope: durable interrupt and resume of a Story delivery run
assumptions: tests inject Git and command runners so live git is not required
lint and hygiene remain blocked probe scripts
